notes.title: Patch 1.03 And Going Rogue Announcement!
notes.notes:
Welcome Citizens!

This time we're proud to announce that Tartapolis is Going Rogue! 

And this time it coincides with the release of patch 1.03! This release feature a lot of new elements, quality of life fixes and more! As a added bonus we added TWO new guns to the game! They are well hidden, but u know what they say... it's darkest under a street lamp! Also to kick things off - we planned a whopping 66 percent discount! Talk about patch celebration! We invite all to participate in the festival! Let's GO ROGUE together!

New guns are found in War Caches! Keep your eyes open! Update available to all Players! Patch goes live with the start of the Festival!

notes.title: Tartapolis Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Attention Citizens~!


The City administration has adopted the following changes!

- reduction of memory usage
- significant reduction of hdd installation requirements 
- overall workload greatly reduced
- bot fixes
- rebalance towards harder gameplay

Following community requests, a free Tartapolis demo is now available for download! Just go to:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1072110/Tartapolis/

and click Download to play!

We are working hard on implementing many changes suggested by the players! Subsequent updates are in the making right now! Stay tuned for future updates and announcements!

Join our discord!

https://discord.gg/ARVtpWZcXK

Kind regards

City Administration

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Attention Citizens!

We are proud to announce the 1.0.1 update!

Changelog:

- we added a functional map(M on the keyboard or right analog button)
- added a new enemy(small Cockroach)
- changes to popup system(highly requested)
- changes to enemy progression
- fixes to player(speedup and others, more coming in the next update!)
- rebalancing of some weapons
- many small bugfixes

Starting now, anyone can opt for a beta test, to check out new features ahead of the current version!(1.0.1) Just go to Preferences, Betas, Opt.. this version is going to be ahead from the main release but untested.

The next update(1.0.2) is going to contain optimizations and changes to the Player, we are also working on joypad remapping. We will post an update as soon as it is available.

Join our discord!

https://discord.gg/ARVtpWZcXK

notes.title: Tartapolis Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35420834/b87af59b2562f2d77bf0add5e5d043cf12fe9b05.png

Greetings from Poland.

We decided to push back the game release due to a large title launching very near our current date. this way we hope to get a little more time to polish the game and give players a chance to spot our title on the store "shelves" The new release date is:

25.12.2020 r.

With Tartapolis we wanted to bring back the oldschool felling of classical J-RPG, coupled with perspective from Castlevania and action from Resident Evil. The game tells a story, and it's the main driving force. Environment is dynamic, and conditions change when going through the storyline. As the game progresses, new challenges present itself. Richard, the game's protagonist has to develop skills and equipment to deal with the City and progress the story. On his path are diverse enemies and many bosses. Strange characters, S.W.A.R.M(city police) units, bots and creatures inhabit this place, but deeper great darkness awaits! 

To achieve the dark mood and techno feel of the game we used Photoshop as the main editing tool for maximum control of 2d graphics displayed in the game. A lot of visual data was fed through PS in the form of 3d renderings using proprietary "cell" shader to achieve the game look and mood. This also allowed us to optimize high resolution images and achieve native 4k resolution(game's HIGH setting). This mode requires quite a bit of data to be moved around and we would recommend to install the game on SSD drive for optimal loading times. 

Finally, a little bit about the studio. We're from Poland, currently working remotely a small team of just 2 people. The game development took about two and a half years and it's almost complete now. During that time we gave ourselves total creative freedom to give our game a lot of heart. It is all about the details, small stories NPC tell or notes you find on the way that bring this world to light and unravel the true meaning of the City. We hope everyone enjoys Tartapolis.
